title: Read Exactly N Bytes
prompt: POSIX. Implement `ssize_t read_exact(int fd, void *buf, size_t n)` — loop recv until exactly n bytes are accumulated; return n, or -1 on EOF-before-complete (peer closed mid-message), error, or NULL/zero-argument misuse (n==0 returns 0 immediately). Partial data stays in buf on failure — the tests only check return values.

tests.name: complete read
tests.hint: 3 bytes arrive; read_exact returns 3 after one recv — the trivial case.

tests.name: split delivery
tests.hint: Three 1-byte sends: the loop must keep recv-ing until 3 accumulate.

tests.name: EOF before complete
tests.hint: 1 byte then EOF: a message cut short is an error, not a success.

tests.name: zero is immediate
tests.hint: n==0 asks for nothing: return 0 without touching the socket.
